title: Online Kirana Store: Customer Website + Admin ERP + POS Billing with Shared Inventory

requirements.text: Implement core backend data models and APIs in the single Motoko actor for a dry-grocery kirana store: products (variants/units), suppliers, inventory (including min-stock threshold, expiry date, and damaged stock), customers, staff accounts with roles/permissions, carts, online orders (with status history), offline POS sales, returns, and refunds.

quotes: Create a full-stack, production-ready Online Grocery Website with a powerful Admin ERP for a small Kirana (dry grocery only).

acceptanceCriteria: Backend persists all entities across upgrades using stable-friendly storage patterns.
Products support categories relevant to dry grocery (e.g., rice/atta/dal/oil/snacks/soap/shampoo/packaged) and explicitly excludes fruits/vegetables by catalog design.
Inventory updates are transactionally applied for: online order placement/cancellation/refund and offline POS completed sale.
Each order maintains a status timeline (placed/packed/out for delivery/delivered/cancelled/refunded).

requirements.text: Build a mobile-first customer storefront: browse/search dry-grocery catalog, product details, add-to-cart, checkout, view order history, and track order status.

quotes: Generate: Customer website

acceptanceCriteria: Customer can search and filter products and add/remove items from cart.
Checkout creates an online order in the backend and reduces inventory appropriately (with stock validation).
Customer can view all their orders and see the latest status and full status history per order.
UI is optimized for mobile web with large tap targets (big buttons) and fast navigation.

requirements.text: Add authentication flows for customers and staff accounts, supporting: register with mobile number or email, OTP verification, login via OTP or password, and password reset via OTP; enforce role-based access for Admin ERP staff roles (cashier, delivery boy, manager).

quotes: Customers must be able to: Register with mobile number or email
Login via OTP or password
Reset password via OTP
Staff Roles Cashier Delivery boy Manager Each with login & permissions

acceptanceCriteria: Customer registration requires verifying either a phone number or email via an OTP challenge before account activation.
Customer login supports password login and OTP login.
Password reset requires an OTP challenge tied to the email/phone identifier.
Staff accounts are restricted by role: cashier can access Billing Mode; delivery boy can access assigned deliveries; manager/admin can manage products, inventory, orders, and analytics.
All protected routes in the frontend redirect/deny access when the role is insufficient.

requirements.text: Implement shared inventory synchronization between online orders and offline POS sales so that stock changes in one channel are visible in the other; provide near-real-time updates in the UI via polling/refresh patterns.

quotes: Both must use one shared real-time inventory system.

acceptanceCriteria: Placing an online order reduces inventory and is immediately reflected in Admin ERP inventory views.
Completing an offline POS sale reduces inventory and is immediately reflected in the customer storefront availability checks.
Frontend uses a consistent refresh strategy (e.g., React Query refetch intervals/manual refresh) to reflect stock/order changes without WebSockets.
When stock is insufficient, online checkout and POS billing both block completion with a clear error message.

requirements.text: Create an Admin ERP web app area with: product management (add/edit), supplier-wise stock management, min stock alert configuration, expiry tracking, damaged stock recording, and inventory list views.

quotes: Admin can: Add / edit products
Set min stock alerts
Expiry & damaged stock
Supplier wise stock

acceptanceCriteria: Admin can create and edit products including pricing, units, and category.
Admin can assign inventory to suppliers and view stock grouped by supplier.
Admin can set and edit min-stock thresholds per product and see a low-stock list.
Admin can record expiry dates and mark items as damaged, with these quantities excluded from sellable stock.
Inventory screens support search and basic filters (low stock, expiring soon, expired, damaged).

requirements.text: Add Excel (.xlsx) import/export tools in Admin ERP for stock/products: upload an .xlsx to bulk create/update products and inventory; download current stock/export reports.

quotes: Upload stock via Excel (.xlsx)
Download stock

acceptanceCriteria: Admin can download an export file containing current products + inventory (including min stock, expiry, damaged, supplier).
Admin can upload an .xlsx file that is validated client-side and then applied server-side with a clear success/error summary (created/updated/skipped rows).
Imports are idempotent where possible (same product identifier updates rather than duplicates).

requirements.text: Implement Admin “Billing Mode” (phone-based POS) optimized for Android browsers: product search, quantity entry, add to bill, apply discount, select payment method (Cash/UPI), and complete sale; on completion, save the sale and deduct stock from the shared inventory.

quotes: Admin panel must include “Billing Mode” that works on any Android phone.
Cashier can: Search product Enter quantity Add to bill Select Cash / UPI Apply discount Click Complete Sale
System must: Deduct stock Save sale Sync with online stock

acceptanceCriteria: Billing Mode UI is mobile-first with large buttons and fast search.
Cashier can build a bill with multiple line items, set quantities, and apply a bill-level discount.
Cashier can select payment method (Cash or UPI) before completing the sale.
Completing a sale creates a POS sale record and reduces inventory accordingly.
POS sales are included in admin analytics (sales totals, cash vs UPI).

requirements.text: Implement order management workflows in Admin ERP: accept/reject orders, update statuses (placed/packed/out for delivery/delivered/cancelled/refunded), assign delivery staff, track assigned orders, approve returns, and process refunds.

quotes: Admin can: Accept / reject orders Assign delivery Track orders Approve returns Process refunds

acceptanceCriteria: Admin can view new orders and accept or reject them with a recorded reason for rejection.
Admin can update order statuses and each change is recorded in order status history.
Admin can assign an order to a delivery boy account; delivery boy can see only assigned orders.
Admin can mark returns approved and mark refunds processed, updating order state accordingly.
Refunding/cancelling restores inventory according to defined rules (e.g., only if it was previously deducted).

requirements.text: Add notification event logging for order status changes and key admin alerts: new order, low stock, and high value order; expose views in Admin ERP and customer order pages showing the notification history.

quotes: Whenever order status changes... Customer must receive: SMS Email
Admin also gets: New order alert Low stock alert High value order alert

acceptanceCriteria: Every order status change emits a notification event record (who/when/what changed).
Admin ERP shows an alerts panel with: new order events, low-stock triggers, and high-value order triggers (threshold configurable).
Customer order detail page shows a history of status changes (and related notification events).

requirements.text: Create Admin dashboard analytics combining online orders and offline POS sales: online+offline sales totals, cash vs UPI breakdown, profit (based on cost vs selling price), stock alerts, top selling items, and expiry warnings.

quotes: Admin Dashboard Show: Online + Offline sales Cash vs UPI Profit Stock alerts Top selling items Expiry warnings

acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard shows total sales for a selected time range and splits by online vs offline.
Dashboard shows payment breakdown for offline sales (Cash vs UPI).
Profit metrics compute using stored cost price vs selling price (where available).
Dashboard shows low-stock and expiring-soon widgets and a top-selling products list.

requirements.text: Implement AI-style insights as on-device/back-end deterministic analytics (no external AI services): demand forecasting (e.g., moving average), reorder suggestions (based on forecast + lead time + min stock), smart pricing suggestions (rule-based), fraud/anomaly flags (e.g., unusual discounts/refunds), and dead stock alerts (no sales for N days).

quotes: 🧠 AI Tools Include: Demand forecast Reorder suggestions Smart pricing Fraud detection Dead stock alert

acceptanceCriteria: Admin can open an ‘Insights’ page that shows forecasted demand per product for a configurable window.
Reorder suggestions list products with recommended reorder quantity based on current sellable stock and forecast assumptions.
Dead stock report lists products with no sales in a configurable period.
Anomaly report flags high discount rates, frequent refunds, or unusually high order values relative to history using transparent rules.

requirements.text: Implement dark mode and light mode across customer site, Admin ERP, and Billing Mode, with a clean kirana-style UI and consistently large, touch-friendly controls.

quotes: 🎨 UI Mobile friendly Fast Clean kirana style Big buttons Dark + Light mode

acceptanceCriteria: User can toggle dark/light mode and the choice persists locally.
Key interactive controls (add to cart, checkout, complete sale) meet a large touch target standard.
All primary screens render correctly on common mobile widths without horizontal scrolling.

requirements.text: Establish a coherent, distinct visual theme for the entire app (customer + admin + billing) with a kirana-market aesthetic (avoid blue/purple): define color palette, typography, spacing, and component usage guidelines and apply consistently.

quotes: 🎨 UI Mobile friendly Fast Clean kirana style

acceptanceCriteria: Theme uses a consistent palette and typography across all screens (customer/admin/billing).
Theme avoids blue/purple as the primary brand colors.
Primary/secondary action styling is consistent and accessible in both dark and light modes.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor (no multi-service architecture).

Only Internet Identity is supported as a built-in third-party authentication mechanism; SMS/Email/WhatsApp gateway integrations are not available in this build environment, so OTP delivery must be implemented as a non-SMS/non-email fallback (e.g., on-screen OTP for testing) while preserving the OTP verification flows.
No WebSockets/real-time push; use polling/refresh patterns for near-real-time inventory and order updates.
No external databases (e.g., PostgreSQL/MySQL/MongoDB) or cloud provider services; persist data within the Internet Computer canister.
No external LLM/AI service integrations; ‘AI tools’ must be implemented as deterministic analytics/heuristics.
nonGoals: Native Android app (Billing Mode must run in a mobile browser).
True SMS/email/WhatsApp message sending via third-party gateways (only in-app event logs/fallback delivery in this environment).
Selling fruits/vegetables or features specific to produce (weight-based live pricing, etc.).

Mobile hero banner illustration showing dry grocery items (rice/atta/dal/oil/snacks/soap/shampoo) in a clean flat style (hero-banner.dim_1600x600.png)
Set of 8 category icons in matching style (categories-icons-sprite.dim_1024x1024.png)
